dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: I'm Lin, the Sergeant of Millelith's troops here in Chenyu Vale. I'm in charge of border defense and the defense of Yilong Wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: The flow of people here in Yilong Wharf is only a little slower than in Liyue Harbor, but we have a limited number of troops, so things are extremely difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: I was sent here because of my youth and high stamina, which are required for the heavy workload here.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: On the other hand, constantly training our young soldiers is also key for our forces to improve continuously.

dialogues.speaker: Sergeant Lin
dialogues.text: The border defense of Chenyu Vale and the defense of Yilong Wharf have seen no trouble since I took up the post.
